critique.evidence: Across desktop, tablet, and mobile, the screen presents a cohesive, polished dark-grid visual system with disciplined cyan/green/red/yellow accents, strong headline hierarchy, crisp borders, and consistent mono metadata. Desktop composition balances the replay table with the trace analysis; tablet stacking remains orderly; mobile successfully converts the table into readable vertical records without visible clipping. It falls short of exceptional because mobile metadata and explanatory copy become very small and dense, the two-column decision card is cramped, and the stacked replay creates a long, visually repetitive page.
critique.fix: Increase mobile body/meta type and line spacing, stack the Legacy and Intent Integrity comparison vertically at the narrowest breakpoint, and tighten repetitive event-card spacing or add stronger grouping cues to reduce the long-scroll monotony.
